paragraphs: Rav Acha the elder; another reading, Tava. He spoke to Rav Assi and was Rav Mari bar Issur’s son. Kiddushin 65b: Mar Zutra and Rav Adda (it should be Acha) the elder, sons of Rav Mari, came before Rav Ashi. Kiddushin 21a; Zevachim 91a; Menachot 6a: Rav Acha the elder spoke to Rav Ashi; Bava Kamma, end of Hammanniach, and 106, end of a. For his burial see Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai. Shalshelet Hakkabbalah 34a: “Rav Mari bar Rachel, Shmuel’s daughter, had Issur the convert as father. There were four brothers, all sages: this one, Acha, Mar Zutra, and Rava; Rashi’s view in Hashokher.” End quotation. He erred: there were three brothers, sons of Mari bar Issur—Rav Acha the elder, Mar Zutra, and Rava. (See Yuchasin in Rashi’s name, Ha'omer, though Rava is not there.) He understood Mari, Rav Acha, Mar Zutra, and Rava as Issur the convert’s sons.
